name: Tyro Naturalist
description: You had just begun your quest to come to an understanding with Mother Nature when the world as you knew it ended.

name: Primitive Forager
description: You learned to live from what the forest could provide.

name: Primitive Woodworker
description: You can turn fallen wood into useful tools and shelter.

name: Primitive Hunter
description: You tracked game with simple weapons and patience.

name: Primitive Fisher
description: You survived by finding and preserving food near the water.

name: Primitive Builder
description: You know how to make a safe camp from mud, sticks, and stone.

name: Primitive Toolmaker
description: You shaped the first tools your small community relied on.

name: Primitive Herbalist
description: You know which plants, bark, and fungi can help keep people alive.

name: Primitive Weaver
description: You made cordage and containers from bark, fibre, and leather.

name: Primitive Scout
description: You travelled light and could make camp almost anywhere.

name: Primitive Firekeeper
description: You guarded the embers and kept your group warm through the long nights.
